Relief from final judgment (FRCP 60(b))


Grounds for reliefTime to file
  • Mistake, inadvertence, surprise, excusable neglect
  • Newly discovered evidence
  • Fraud, misrepresentation, misconduct
Within one year
  • Void judgment (eg, lack of jurisdiction)
  • Judgment: satisfied, released, discharged based on reversed or vacated judgment or will violate equity if applied prospectively
  • Other reason justifying relief (rare)
Within reasonable time
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A default judgment is a final judgment that is entered when the defendant has failed to timely serve an answer. A party can move for extraordinary relief from a default judgment (or any other final judgment) in limited circumstances. The motion must typically be filed within a reasonable time, but it must be filed within one year from the entry of judgment when asserting any of the following grounds for relief:
  • The judgment was due to the court's or party's mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect.
  • The movant discovered new evidence.
  • The nonmovant engaged in misrepresentation, misconduct, or fraud.

A motion based on mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect will be granted if the movant also demonstrates a meritorious defense.

Here, the bicyclist's failure to timely serve an answer was excusable because he was in a coma. And the affidavit attached to the bicyclist's motion provides a meritorious defense. That is because the eyewitness statement challenges the substance of the driver's claim (rather than merely raising a technical or procedural issue). Therefore, the court will likely grant the bicyclist's motion to set aside the default judgment.

(Choice A) A motion for extraordinary relief based on excusable neglect must be made within one year after the judgment was entered - not after the complaint was filed.

(Choice B) The driver did not engage in misconduct since he was unaware that the bicyclist was in a coma. However, the bicyclist may still obtain relief since his failure to file a timely answer was excusable.

(Choice C) Service of process is proper if it is delivered to the defendant's dwelling and left with a resident of suitable age and discretion. Most teenagers are of suitable age and discretion since they possess the limited capacity necessary to comprehend the situation. Therefore, service of process on the bicyclist's 16-year-old daughter was proper.

Educational objective: A motion for extraordinary relief from a final judgment (eg, default judgment) based on mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect will be granted if the movant demonstrates a meritorious defense.

选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 2%，C选项 42%，D选项 42%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

终局判决的补救 (FRCP 60(b))


补救理由申请时限
  • 错误、疏忽、意外、可原谅的疏忽
  • 新发现的证据
  • 欺诈、虚假陈述、不当行为
一年内
  • 判决无效（例如，缺乏管辖权）
  • 判决：已履行、已解除、已基于被推翻或撤销的判决而免除，或如果继续适用将违反衡平法
  • 其他可证明补救具有正当性的理由（罕见）
在合理时间内
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》。

缺席判决是指在被告未能及时送达答辩状时作出的一种终局判决。在有限的情况下，一方当事人可以针对缺席判决（或任何其他终局判决）申请非常规补救。该动议通常必须在合理时间内提出，但如果主张以下任一补救理由，则必须在判决作出后的一年内提出：
  • 判决是由于法院或当事人的错误、疏忽、意外或可原谅的疏忽所致。
  • 动议人发现了新证据。
  • 非动议人有虚假陈述、不当行为或欺诈行为。

如果动议人同时证明了存在有理据的抗辩，那么基于错误、疏忽、意外或可原谅的疏忽而提出的动议将会被批准。

在本案中，骑行者未能及时送达答辩状是可原谅的，因为他当时处于昏迷状态。并且，骑行者动议所附的宣誓书提供了有理据的抗辩。这是因为目击者的陈述对司机主张的实质内容提出了质疑（而不仅仅是提出一个技术性或程序性问题）。因此，法院很可能会批准骑行者撤销缺席判决的动议。

(选项A) 基于可原谅的疏忽而申请的非常规补救动议，必须在判决作出后一年内提出，而不是在诉状提交后一年内提出。

(选项B) 司机没有不当行为，因为他不知道骑行者处于昏迷状态。然而，骑行者仍然可以获得补救，因为他未能及时提交答辩状是可原谅的。

(选项C) 如果诉讼文书送达到被告的住所，并交给一位年龄和判断力适当的居民，则送达是适当的。大多数青少年都具有适当的年龄和判断力，因为他们拥有理解情况所需的有限能力。因此，向骑行者16岁的女儿送达诉讼文书是适当的。

教学目标： 如果动议人能够证明存在有理据的抗辩，那么基于错误、疏忽、意外或可原谅的疏忽而提出的，旨在从终局判决（如缺席判决）中获得非常规补救的动议，将会被批准。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 60(b) - (c) (extraordinary relief from judgment).
  • 47 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 663 (2019) (meritorious-defense requirement).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Relief from Judgment
核心规则：FRCP 60(b)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第60(b)条，法院可以在以下情况下解除终局判决（包括缺席判决）：

  • 理由：错误、疏忽、意外或可原谅的疏忽 (Excusable Neglect)。
  • 时效：必须在判决作出后一年内提出动议。
  • 前提：动议人通常需要证明自己拥有有理据的抗辩 (Meritorious Defense)。

为什么选 D？

本题考察的是法院是否会基于“可原谅的疏忽”撤销缺席判决。法院倾向于根据案件的是非曲直（Merits）而非技术性违规来审理案件。

  • 存在可原谅的疏忽：
    被告处于昏迷状态 (Coma) 且不知情，这是无法回应诉讼的极端正当理由。
  • 符合时效要求：
    动议是在缺席判决作出后10个月提出的，未超过1年的限制。
  • 关键点：有理据的抗辩 (Meritorious Defense)：
    仅仅有借口是不够的，被告还必须证明如果重审，他有胜诉的可能性。题目中提到的宣誓书 (Affidavit) 提供了目击证词，反驳了原告的过失主张。这构成了一个有效的实质性抗辩。

因此，法院很可能会批准该动议，给被告一个辩护的机会。

常见误区与陷阱

❌ 选项 A (时效计算错误)

FRCP 60(b) 的一年时效是从判决作出 (Entry of Judgment) 时开始计算，而不是从提起诉讼 (Filing of Complaint) 时开始。本案中，判决后仅过了10个月。

❌ 选项 B (原告无过错)

撤销判决不一定需要原告有不当行为 (Misconduct)。虽然原告不知道被告昏迷，但这不影响被告基于自身“可原谅的疏忽”寻求救济的权利。

❌ 选项 C (送达程序)

这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。根据 FRCP 4(e)(2)(B)，将传票留在被告住所，并交给适龄且具有判断力 (Suitable age and discretion) 的居住者是有效的。
考点提示：通常认为16岁的青少年具备这种能力，因此送达是合法的 (Proper)。

🎓 MBE 实战技巧

在处理 Default Judgment 问题时，请遵循两步走：

  1. 程序是否合法？ (送达是否有效？法院是否有管辖权？)
  2. 是否有理由撤销？ (如果是 Excusable Neglect，必须同时寻找 Meritorious Defense)。

如果题目中特意提到了“附带了宣誓书证明被告没有过错”，这通常是在暗示你法院会倾向于撤销判决。

An actor brought a federal diversity action against a theater company for breach of contract. Twenty days after discovery closed, the company moved for summary judgment. The company attached to the motion affidavits of its managing director and artistic director and a verified copy of its contract with the actor. In their affidavits, the directors stated facts establishing that the company had fully performed the contract.
The actor's brief opposing the motion relied solely on the allegations of the complaint.
Should the court grant the summary-judgment motion?

choices.a: No, because in deciding the motion, the court must take the allegations and inferences of the complaint as true.
choices.b: No, because the company did not timely file the motion.
choices.c: Yes, because the actor filed no evidence in opposition to the motion.
choices.d: Yes, because there is no genuine dispute as to any material fact and the company is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

The actor's brief opposing the motion relied solely on the allegations of the complaint.

Should the court grant the summary-judgment motion?

一名演员因合同违约对一家戏剧公司提起联邦多元管辖权诉讼 (federal diversity action)。在证据开示 (discovery) 程序结束后二十天，该公司动议申请即决判决 (summary judgment)。该公司在动议中附上了其总经理和艺术总监的宣誓证词 (affidavits)，以及一份经核实的与该演员的合同副本。在其宣誓证词中，两位总监陈述了事实，证明公司已完全履行了合同。

演员反对该动议的辩护状 (brief) 仅依据其诉状 (complaint) 中的指控。

法院是否应批准该即决判决动议？
options:
A. No, because in deciding the motion, the court must take the allegations and inferences of the complaint as true.
不应批准，因为在裁定该动议时，法院必须将诉状中的指控和推论视为真实。

B. No, because the company did not timely file the motion.
不应批准，因为该公司未及时提交该动议。

C. Yes, because the actor filed no evidence in opposition to the motion.
应批准，因为演员未提交任何证据来反对该动议。

D. Yes, because there is no genuine dispute as to any material fact and the company is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.
应批准，因为不存在任何关于重要事实的真实争议 (genuine dispute as to any material fact)，且该公司有权获得法律上的判决 (judgment as a matter of law)。
data.explanation:
In a summary-judgment motion, the movant has the initial burden to show that there is no genuine dispute of material fact and the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law. The movant must support this motion with admissible facts contained in pleadings, affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials. Once the movant satisfies its initial burden, the burden shifts to the nonmovant to avoid summary judgment by either:
  • requesting that the court postpone consideration of the motion until additional discovery can take place (not seen here) or
  • showing specific disputed facts through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible evidence, but not through pleadings.


Here, the company supported its summary-judgment motion through its directors' affidavits, which stated facts establishing that the company had fully performed its contract with the actor. The actor then failed to show specific disputed facts because his brief opposing the motion relied solely on allegations in the complaint. This means that there is no genuine dispute of material fact and the company is entitled to judgment as a matter of law. Therefore, the court should grant the company's motion.

(Choice A) In deciding a summary-judgment motion, a court must view the evidence in the light most favorable to the nonmovant. However, a court is not required to take the complaint's allegations and inferences as true.

(Choice B) A summary-judgment motion may be filed at any time until 30 days after the close of discovery. Therefore, the company timely moved for summary judgment 20 days after discovery closed.

(Choice C) The fact that the actor filed no evidence in opposition to the motion is not, by itself, sufficient for the court to grant the motion. Instead, the motion should be granted because the company satisfied its burden.

Educational objective: The nonmovant can defeat a summary-judgment motion by showing specific disputed facts through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible evidence. However, the nonmovant cannot defeat the motion by relying on allegations in the pleadings.



选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 5%，C选项 21%，D选项 45%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在即决判决动议 (summary-judgment motion)中，动议方 (movant) 负有初始举证责任，需证明不存在任何重要事实的真实争议，且动议方有权获得法律上的判决。动议方必须以诉辩状 (pleadings)、宣誓证词 (affidavits)、声明 (declarations)、证据开示材料 (discovery) 或其他材料中包含的可采纳事实来支持该动议。一旦动议方满足其初始责任，举证责任便转移 (burden shifts) 至非动议方 (nonmovant)，非动议方必须通过以下任一方式来避免即决判决：
  • 请求法院推迟 (postpone) 审议该动议，直至可以进行额外的证据开示（本案中未出现此情况）或
  • 通过宣誓证词、声明、证据开示材料或其他包含可采纳证据的材料展示特定的争议事实，但不能仅通过诉辩状。


在本案中，该公司通过其总监的宣誓证词支持了其即决判决动议，这些证词陈述了事实，证明公司已完全履行了与演员的合同。随后，演员未能展示特定的争议事实，因为他反对该动议的辩护状仅依据其诉状中的指控。这意味着不存在任何重要事实的真实争议，且该公司有权获得法律上的判决。因此，法院应批准该公司的动议。

(选项A) 在裁定即决判决动议时，法院必须以对非动议方最有利的方式看待证据。但是，法院不被要求将诉状的指控和推论视为真实。

(选项B) 即决判决动议可在证据开示程序结束后的30天内随时提出。因此，该公司在证据开示结束后20天提出的即决判决动议是及时的。

(选项C) 演员未提交任何证据来反对该动议这一事实本身，并不足以让法院批准该动议。相反，该动议应被批准是因为公司满足了其举证责任。

教学目标： 非动议方可以通过宣誓证词、声明、证据开示或其他包含可采纳证据的材料来展示特定的争议事实，从而驳回即决判决动议。但是，非动议方不能依靠诉辩状中的指控来驳回该动议。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 56 (summary judgment).
  • 10A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2727 (4th ed. 2020) (explaining the burden-shifting process of a motion for summary judgment).

MBE 考点解析：即决判决

本题的正确答案是 (D)。

这道题考查的是联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP 56）下 即决判决 (Summary Judgment) 的核心运作机制，特别是关于“举证责任转移” (Burden Shifting) 的规则。

核心法律规则 (FRCP 56):
当动议方 (Movant) 证明案件中不存在“关于重要事实的真实争议” (Genuine dispute as to any material fact) 且其有权获得法律上的判决时，法院应批准即决判决。

⚖️ 逻辑推演步骤

1
动议方的初始责任：
被告（戏剧公司）提交了动议，并附上了宣誓证词 (Affidavits) 和核实后的合同，证明其已完全履行合同。此时，被告已经满足了其初始举证责任，证明了自己没有违约。
2
责任转移 (Burden Shifts)：
一旦动议方提供了证据支持，举证责任就转移到了非动议方（原告演员）。原告必须拿出具体的证据（如反驳的宣誓证词、沉积证词等）来证明存在事实争议。
3
原告的致命错误：
原告仅仅依赖其诉状 (Complaint) 中的指控。在即决判决阶段，仅仅重申诉状中的指控是不够的。原告未能提供任何反驳证据。
4
结论：
由于原告没有提供证据反驳，法院必须依据被告提供的未被反驳的证据（即公司已履约）进行裁决。因此，不存在事实争议，被告胜诉。

🚫 易错点辨析 (Distractors)

陷阱选项 A：关于“视为真实”
选项A混淆了“驳回起诉动议” (Motion to Dismiss, Rule 12(b)(6)) 和“即决判决” (Summary Judgment, Rule 56)。
  • 在 Motion to Dismiss 阶段，法院确实必须假设诉状中的指控为真。
  • 但在 Summary Judgment 阶段，目的是“刺破诉辩状” (Pierce the pleadings) 查看是否有真实证据支持诉讼继续。此时诉状不再被自动视为真实。

选项 B (时间问题)：
根据 FRCP 56(b)，除非地方法规另有规定，当事人可在证据开示 (Discovery) 结束后 30 天内提出即决判决动议。本案中是 20 天，因此是及时的。

选项 C (表述不严谨)：
虽然原告确实没提交证据，但法院批准动议的法律标准是“不存在重要事实争议且动议方有权获得法律判决”（即选项 D 的表述）。选项 C 描述了现象，而 D 描述了法律依据。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 民事诉讼题中，一旦看到一方提交了 Affidavits 或 Discovery materials 支持其动议，而另一方仅仅依赖 Pleadings (Complaint/Answer)，这通常意味着依赖 Pleadings 的一方将败诉。记住口诀："Evidence beats Allegations" (证据胜过指控)。

MBE Civil Procedure | Topic: Summary Judgment

questions.question:
A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in federal district court to determine liability in a fatal auto accident. During jury deliberations, a juror brought a highway manual that he had found at the local library into the jury room. The manual listed the skid mark distances created when a vehicle brakes at various speeds. The jurors used the manual's data to analyze the admitted photographic evidence of the skid marks from the accident scene. They determined that the plaintiff must have been traveling at a recklessly high speed, which caused the accident. Based on the data from the highway manual, the jury returned a verdict in favor of the defendant. The judge presiding over the case entered a final judgment consistent with that verdict on the same day. The plaintiff made no posttrial motions and did not file a notice of appeal.
Sixty days after the court entered final judgment, one of the jurors went to the presiding judge's chambers and told her about the highway manual. The juror then told the judge that the data from the highway manual was the primary reason why the jury found in favor of the defendant. The judge was concerned about this revelation and asked her clerk to research whether the court could order a new trial. After extensive research, the clerk determined that the judge may not order a new trial sua sponte in the action.
What is the most likely reason the clerk determined that the judge may not order a new trial sua sponte?

choices.a: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte.
choices.b: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte unless a party engaged in misconduct.
choices.c: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte until an appeal from the judgment is filed.
choices.d: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte when more than 28 days have passed since the entry of final judgment.

data.questionStem:
Q88154

A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in federal district court to determine liability in a fatal auto accident. During jury deliberations, a juror brought a highway manual that he had found at the local library into the jury room. The manual listed the skid mark distances created when a vehicle brakes at various speeds. The jurors used the manual's data to analyze the admitted photographic evidence of the skid marks from the accident scene. They determined that the plaintiff must have been traveling at a recklessly high speed, which caused the accident. Based on the data from the highway manual, the jury returned a verdict in favor of the defendant. The judge presiding over the case entered a final judgment consistent with that verdict on the same day. The plaintiff made no posttrial motions and did not file a notice of appeal.

Sixty days after the court entered final judgment, one of the jurors went to the presiding judge's chambers and told her about the highway manual. The juror then told the judge that the data from the highway manual was the primary reason why the jury found in favor of the defendant. The judge was concerned about this revelation and asked her clerk to research whether the court could order a new trial.

May the judge order a new trial?

一名原告在联邦地区法院对一名被告提起了州籍多元之诉（diversity action），以确定一起致命车祸的责任归属。在陪审团审议期间，一名陪审员将他在当地图书馆找到的一本公路手册带入了陪审团室。该手册列出了车辆在不同速度下刹车时产生的刹车痕迹距离。陪审员们使用该手册的数据来分析法庭采纳的事故现场刹车痕迹的照片证据。他们认定原告必定是以鲁莽（recklessly）的高速行驶，从而导致了事故。根据公路手册的数据，陪审团作出了有利于被告的裁决。主审此案的法官在当天作出了与该裁决一致的终局判决。原告没有提出审后动议，也没有提交上诉通知。

在法院作出终局判决六十天后，其中一名陪审员来到主审法官的办公室，告诉了她关于公路手册的事情。该陪审员接着告诉法官，公路手册的数据是陪审团作出有利于被告裁决的主要原因。法官对此披露感到担忧，并要求其书记员研究法院是否可以下令进行新的审判。

法官可以下令进行新的审判吗？
options:
A. No, because a judge may not order a new trial sua sponte.
不可以，因为法官不得依职权（sua sponte）下令进行新的审判。

B. No, because a new trial cannot be granted when more than 28 days have passed since the entry of final judgment.
不可以，因为在终局判决作出超过28天后，不得批准进行新的审判。

C. Yes, because the court may grant a new trial until an appeal from the judgment is docketed.
可以，因为在对判决的上诉被立案（docketed）前，法院可以批准进行新的审判。

D. Yes, because the court must order a new trial when there is evidence of juror misconduct.
可以，因为当有陪审员不当行为的证据时，法院必须下令进行新的审判。
data.explanation:
Posttrial relief


ReliefGroundsTiming
Attorney's feesStatute or rule allows recovery≤ 14 days after entry of final judgment
Judgment as matter of lawEvidence legally insufficient to find for nonmovant≤ 28 days after entry of final judgment
New trial
  • Prejudicial trial error
  • Prejudicial misconduct by judge, attorney, party, juror
  • Verdict not supported by clear weight of evidence
  • Verdict based on false/nonexistent evidence
  • Excessive or inadequate damages
  • Newly discovered evidence
Alter/amend judgment
  • Manifest error of law or fact is basis for judgment
  • Intervening change in controlling law
  • Newly discovered evidence
Correction of mistake
  • Clerical mistake
  • Mistake arising from oversight or omission
Freely OR with appellate court's leave if docketed
Extraordinary relief
  • Mistake, inadvertence, surprise, excusable neglect
  • Newly discovered evidence
  • Fraud, misrepresentation, misconduct
≤ 1 year after entry of final judgment
Extraordinary relief
  • Void judgment
  • Judgment satisfied, released, discharged
  • Other reason justifying relief
Within reasonable time
A district court may order a new trial by granting a party's motion OR on its own initiative (ie, sua sponte) (Choice A). A court may do so on any ground that has previously provided a basis for a new trial in federal court. One such ground is when a juror (or a judge, attorney, or party) engaged in prejudicial misconduct. Here, prejudicial misconduct occurred when a juror brought in, and the jury based its verdict on, evidence outside the record - the highway manual.

However, a party's motion or a court's sua sponte order for a new trial must be filed within 28 days after entry of the final judgment. Since 60 days have passed since final judgment was entered, the judge may not order a new trial.

(Choice C) Under FRCP 60(a), the district court may - on its own initiative or a party's motion - correct a clerical mistake or a mistake arising from an oversight or omission in a judgment until an appeal from the judgment is docketed. However, this rule does not allow the district court to grant a new trial on the basis of juror misconduct or for any other reason.

(Choice D) While a court may order a new trial within 28 days of entering final judgment because of juror misconduct, it is not required to do so. Ordering a new trial is a discretionary - ie, not mandatory or automatic - ruling of the court.

Educational objective: A party may move for a new trial - or a court may order a new trial on its own initiative - within 28 days after the entry of final judgment.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 27%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 50%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

审后救济


救济理由时限
律师费法规或规则允许补偿≤ 终局判决作出后14天内
作为法律问题的判决 (Judgment as matter of law)证据在法律上不足以支持非动议方的裁决≤ 终局判决作出后28天内
新的审判
  • 存在偏见的审判错误
  • 法官、律师、当事人、陪审员存在偏见的不当行为
  • 裁决没有明显优势证据的支持
  • 裁决基于虚假或不存在的证据
  • 损害赔偿金过多或不足
  • 新发现的证据
变更/修正判决
  • 判决基于明显的法律或事实错误
  • 有管辖权的法律发生中期变化
  • 新发现的证据
更正错误
  • 书记员的笔误
  • 因疏忽或遗漏引起的错误
自由进行，或若已上诉立案则需经上诉法院许可（leave）
非常规救济
  • 错误、疏忽、意外、可原谅的过失
  • 新发现的证据
  • 欺诈、虚假陈述、不当行为
≤ 终局判决作出后1年内
非常规救济
  • 无效判决
  • 判决已履行、解除、免除
  • 其他证明救济合理性的理由
在合理时间内
地区法院可以通过批准一方当事人的动议或依其职权（即 sua sponte）下令进行新的审判 (选项 A) 。法院可以基于任何在联邦法院曾作为新审判依据的理由这样做。其中一个理由是当陪审员（或法官、律师或当事人）有存在偏见的不当行为时。在此案中，存在偏见的不当行为发生于一名陪审员带入且陪审团将其裁决基于卷宗外证据——即该公路手册之上。

然而，一方当事人提出的新审判动议或法院依职权下达的新审判命令必须在终局判决作出后28天内提交。由于终局判决作出至今已过60天，法官不得下令进行新的审判。

(选项 C) 根据 FRCP 第60(a)条，地区法院可以依职权或根据一方当事人的动议，在对判决的上诉被立案（docketed）前，更正判决中的书记员笔误或因疏忽或遗漏引起的错误。但是，该规则不允许地区法院基于陪审员不当行为或任何其他理由批准进行新的审判。

(选项 D) 尽管法院可以因陪审员不当行为在终局判决作出后28天内下令进行新的审判，但并非必须这样做。下令进行新的审判是法院的一项自由裁量——即非强制性或自动的——裁定。

教学目的：一方当事人可以在终局判决作出后28天内提出新审判的动议，或者法院可以依职权下令进行新的审判。

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (联邦民事诉讼规则)。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 59 (motion for a new trial).
  • Montgomery Ward & Co. v. Duncan, 311 U.S. 243, 251 (1940) (articulating grounds for a new trial).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Post-Trial Motions
核心考点：FRCP 59 (New Trial)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP) 第59条，无论是当事人提出动议，还是法院依职权 (sua sponte) 下令，进行新的审判 (New Trial) 的最后期限均为终局判决作出后的 28天 内。

案情关键点分析

本题考察的是法院在没有当事人动议的情况下，是否有权因陪审员不当行为 (Juror Misconduct) 下令重审，以及该权力的时间限制。

  • 事件：陪审员引入外部证据（公路手册），导致裁决不公。
  • 时间轴：终局判决 (Final Judgment) 已作出 60天。
  • 法官意图：依职权 (sua sponte) 下令重审。
为什么选 B？

答案：不可以，因为时间已过。

虽然陪审员的不当行为（引入庭外证据）确实是批准新审判的有效理由，但程序性规则（时效）优先于实体理由。

FRCP 59(d) 明确规定，法院可以依职权下令进行新的审判，但必须在判决作出后 28天内 (within 28 days after the entry of judgment)。

在本案中，判决已作出60天，法院已经失去了根据 FRCP 59 下令重审的管辖权。因此，无论理由多么充分，法官都不能再下令进行新的审判。

干扰项排除
选项 A (错误)：
错误地认为法官不能依职权 (sua sponte) 下令重审。实际上法官有权这样做，只是必须在28天内。
选项 C (错误)：
混淆了 FRCP 60(a)（更正笔误）和 FRCP 59（新审判）。虽然在上诉立案前法院可以更正笔误，但这不适用于批准“新的审判”。
选项 D (错误)：
虽然陪审员不当行为是重审的理由，但法院并非“必须”(must) 下令，这通常是自由裁量权。更重要的是，28天的时效是硬性规定，超过时效即便是正当理由也无法依此规则救济。
💡 MBE 备考小贴士

在联邦民事诉讼法 (Civil Procedure) 中，"28 Days" 是一个非常关键的数字，请务必牢记：

  • RJMOL (Renewed Judgment as a Matter of Law) 动议：判决后 28 天内。
  • New Trial (新审判) 动议：判决后 28 天内。
  • Motion to Amend Judgment (修改判决) 动议：判决后 28 天内。

如果题目中出现 "30 days", "60 days" 或 "months later" 且涉及上述动议，通常答案都是“Denied/No”，理由是 Untimely。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for fraud in federal court. The complaint contained a short and plain statement of facts giving rise to the claim. One week after being served with process, the defendant filed and served an answer that denied the plaintiff's allegations. Five days later, the defendant filed and served a motion for a more definite statement. The motion alleged that the complaint failed to state the circumstances giving rise to the claim with particularity and specified the details that needed to be included.
Should the court grant the defendant's motion?

choices.c: Yes, because the circumstances giving rise to the claim must be stated with particularity.

A plaintiff sued a defendant for fraud in federal court. The complaint contained a short and plain statement of facts giving rise to the claim. One week after being served with process, the defendant filed and served an answer that denied the plaintiff's allegations. Five days later, the defendant filed and served a motion for a more definite statement. Should the court grant the defendant's motion?

一名原告在联邦法院以欺诈为由起诉一名被告。起诉状包含了一份简明扼要的事实陈述，说明了诉求的起因。在收到诉讼文书一周后，被告提交并送达了一份否认原告指控的答辩状。五天后，被告提交并送达了一份要求更明确陈述的动议。该动议声称，起诉状未能具体陈述产生诉求的情形，并指明了需要补充的细节。

法院是否应批准被告的动议？
options:
A. No, because the complaint contained a short and plain statement of the facts giving rise to the claim.
不应，因为起诉状包含了对产生诉求事实的简明扼要的陈述。

B. No, because the motion was filed after the defendant's responsive pleading was filed.
不应，因为该动议是在被告提交应诉状之后提出的。

C. Yes, because the circumstances giving rise to the claim must be stated with particularity.
应，因为产生诉求的情形必须具体陈述。

D. Yes, because the motion was filed within 21 days after the defendant was served with process.

FRCP 12 motions


Motion asserting any of the following defenses:
12(b)Lack of subject-matter or personal jurisdiction, Improper venue, Insufficient process or service of process, Failure to state claim upon which relief can be granted, Failure to join required party
12(c)Motion for judgment on the pleadings
12(e)Motion for more definite statement in pleading
12(f)Motion to strike insufficient defense or immaterial matter from pleading
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12(e) allows a party to move for a more definite statement of a pleading that is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably draft a responsive pleading. This motion is appropriate when a complaint does not contain the requisite specificity - eg, fails to state the circumstances giving rise to a fraud claim with particularity. A motion for a more definite statement must:

  • specify the pleading's defects and the details needed to cure these defects and

  • be made before filing a responsive pleading (eg, answer).†


If the court grants the motion, the nonmovant must provide a more definite statement within 14 days after receiving notice of the order or a time otherwise set by the court. Failure to do so allows the court to strike the pleading or issue another appropriate order.

Here, the defendant's motion for a more definite statement alleged that the plaintiff's complaint failed to state the circumstances giving rise to the fraud claim with particularity and specified the details sought to cure this defect. However, the motion was not timely since it was filed after the answer. Therefore, the court should deny the defendant's motion.

†Since the purpose of a motion for a more definite statement is to help a party adequately answer a vague pleading, the motion must be made before the answer is filed.

(Choices A & C) A complaint generally need only contain a short and plain statement of the claim showing that the plaintiff is entitled to relief. However, the circumstances giving rise to a fraud claim must be stated with particularity.

(Choice D) A defendant generally must file an answer within 21 days after being served with process. Here, the defendant timely filed and served an answer one week after being served with process. But the motion for a more definite statement was untimely since it was made after the defendant filed an answer.

Educational objective: A party may move for a more definite statement of a pleading that is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably draft a responsive pleading. This motion must (1) specify the pleading's defects and the details sought that will cure these defects and (2) be made before filing a responsive pleading.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 49%（正确选项），C选项 28%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

FRCP 第12条动议


主张以下任一抗辩的动议：
12(b)缺乏标的物管辖权或属人管辖权、审判地点不当、诉讼文书或送达程序不充分、未能陈述可据以获得救济的诉求、未能追加必要的当事人
12(c)请求依诉状裁决的动议
12(e)请求在诉状中作更明确陈述的动议
12(f)请求从诉状中删除不充分的抗辩或无关紧要事项的动议
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)。

《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(e)条允许一方当事人就一份含糊或模棱两可，以至于该方当事人无法合理起草应诉状的诉状，提出要求更明确陈述的动议。当起诉状不具备必要的具体性时——例如，未能具体陈述引起欺诈诉求的情形——该动议是适当的。一份要求更明确陈述的动议必须：

  • 指明诉状的缺陷以及弥补这些缺陷所需的细节并且

  • 在提交应诉状（例如，答辩状）之前提出。†


如果法院批准该动议，非动议方必须在收到命令通知后的14天内，或在法院另行规定的时间内，提供一份更明确的陈述。若未能这样做，法院可删除该诉状或发出其他适当的命令。

在本案中，被告要求更明确陈述的动议声称，原告的起诉状未能具体陈述引起欺诈诉求的情形，并指明了为弥补此缺陷所寻求的细节。然而，该动议并未及时提出，因为它是在答辩状提交之后才提出的。因此，法院应驳回被告的动议。

†因为要求更明确陈述的动议的目的是帮助一方当事人对一份含糊的诉状进行充分的答辩，所以该动议必须在提交答辩状之前提出。

（选项 A 和 C）起诉状通常只需包含一份简明扼要的诉求陈述，表明原告有权获得救济。然而，引起欺诈诉求的情形必须具体陈述。

（选项 D）被告通常必须在收到诉讼文书后的21天内提交答辩状。在本案中，被告在收到诉讼文书一周后及时提交并送达了答辩状。但是，要求更明确陈述的动议是不合时宜的，因为它是在被告提交答辩状之后才提出的。

教学目标：当一份诉状含糊或模棱两可，以至于一方当事人无法合理起草应诉状时，该方当事人可提出要求更明确陈述的动议。该动议必须 (1) 指明诉状的缺陷以及为弥补这些缺陷所寻求的细节，并且 (2) 在提交应诉状之前提出。

References



  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(e) (motion for a more definite statement).


  • 61A Am. Jur. 2d Pleading § 416 (2019) (explaining that a motion for a more definite statement must be made before an answer is filed).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：FRCP 12(e)

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP）中关于“更明确陈述动议” (Motion for a More Definite Statement) 的程序性要求，特别是时间节点的问题。

核心结论：
法院应当拒绝 (Deny) 被告的动议。虽然原告的起诉状确实存在缺陷（欺诈需具体陈述），但被告提出动议的时机是错误的。

1 法律规则详解 (The Rule)

根据 FRCP 12(e)，如果一份诉状（Pleading）含糊不清或模棱两可，导致对方无法合理地准备回应，当事人可以提出“更明确陈述动议”。

关键的时间限制：

该动议必须在提交应诉状 (Responsive Pleading) 之前 提出。

逻辑： 如果你已经提交了答辩状（Answer），说明你已经能够理解诉状并对其进行承认或否认。因此，你在逻辑上已经不再需要“更明确的陈述”了。

2 本案时间线分析

第 0 天： 被告收到诉讼文书 (Served with process)。
第 7 天： 被告提交并送达了答辩状 (Answer)。
⚠️ 此时被告已丧失提出 12(e) 动议的权利。
第 12 天： 被告提出 12(e) 动议。
结果：动议过时 (Untimely)。

3 陷阱辨析：欺诈的特殊性

本题设置了一个极具诱惑性的陷阱，即关于欺诈 (Fraud) 的陈述要求。

规则 要求
FRCP 8(a)
一般规则		 "Short and plain statement"
简明扼要的陈述即可。
FRCP 9(b)
欺诈/错误		 "With particularity"
必须具体陈述（时间、地点、内容等）。

考点分析：

  • 原告确实违反了 FRCP 9(b)，起诉状是有缺陷的。
  • 如果被告在答辩之前提出动议，法院会批准。
  • 但是，程序规则 (Timing) 在此处优先。被告先提交了答辩状，这一行为豁免 (Waived) 了其要求更明确陈述的权利。

4 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 MBE 民事诉讼题目时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 检查动议类型：是 12(b)(6) 驳回起诉？还是 12(e) 更明确陈述？
  2. 检查时间顺序：动议是在答辩状 (Answer) 之前还是之后？
    • 12(e) 动议：必须在答辩前。
    • 12(b) 动议：部分必须在答辩前（如管辖权异议），部分可以在审判前提出。
  3. 不要被实体问题带偏：即使原告的诉状写得很烂（实体缺陷），如果被告违反了程序规则（如逾期），动议依然会被驳回。

questions.question:
A jury sitting in a federal court case returned a verdict that found in favor of the plaintiff and awarded her $100,000. The federal district court entered a final judgment consistent with the jury's verdict.
The defendant immediately filed a notice of appeal, alleging that the district court erred by failing to exclude several pieces of evidence from the jury's consideration. The appellate court docketed the case. The day after the appeal was docketed, the district court discovered that the final judgment listed a $1,000,000 award for the plaintiff.
May the district court correct the mistake?

choices.a: No, because both parties must receive notice and an opportunity to be heard on this action.
choices.b: No, because leave of the appellate court is required once an appeal is docketed.
choices.c: Yes, because a district court may correct clerical mistakes on its own initiative.
choices.d: Yes, because a district court may freely alter and amend final judgments in the interest of justice.

Q88156

A jury sitting in a federal court case returned a verdict that found in favor of the plaintiff and awarded her $100,000. The federal district court entered a final judgment consistent with the jury's verdict.

The defendant immediately filed a notice of appeal, alleging that the district court erred by failing to exclude several pieces of evidence from the jury's consideration. The appellate court docketed the case. The day after the appeal was docketed, the district court discovered that the final judgment listed a $1,000,000 award for the plaintiff.

May the district court correct the mistake?

一个联邦法院案件的陪审团作出了一项有利于原告的裁决，并判给其100,000美元。联邦地区法院根据陪审团的裁决，作出了一项终局判决。

被告立即提交了上诉通知，声称地区法院因未能将几项证据排除在陪审团的考量之外而犯了错误。上诉法院已将该案立卷。在上诉立卷的第二天，地区法院发现终局判决中列出的原告赔偿金为1,000,000美元。

地区法院可以纠正这个错误吗？
options:
A. No, because both parties must receive notice and an opportunity to be heard on this action.
不可以，因为双方当事人都必须收到关于此项行动的通知并有机会就此发表意见。

B. No, because leave of the appellate court is required once an appeal is docketed.
不可以，因为一旦上诉立卷，就需要获得上诉法院的许可。

C. Yes, because a district court may correct clerical mistakes on its own initiative.
可以，因为地区法院可以主动纠正笔误。

D. Yes, because a district court may freely alter and amend final judgments in the interest of justice.
可以，因为地区法院为了司法公正可以自由地更改和修正终局判决。

Posttrial correction of mistakes


(FRCP 60(a)) Type of mistakeDefinitionTime of correction
ClericalMisstatement of court's intent
Eg, court entered judgment for "$10,000" instead of "$100,000"		Before appeal docketed: on court's own initiative or by motion
After appeal docketed: with appellate court's leave
Oversight/omissionExclusion misrepresents court's intent
Eg, judgment failed to include required interest in award
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A district court may correct a clerical mistake or a mistake arising from an oversight or omission in a judgment, order, or other part of the record. The court may do so on its own initiative or pursuant to a party's motion before an appeal from the judgment or order is docketed. But after an appeal is docketed, the district court can correct the mistake only with the appellate court's leave (ie, permission).

Here, a clerical mistake occurred since the jury's verdict awarded the plaintiff $100,000 but the final judgment awarded her $1,000,000. Since the appeal has been docketed, the district court cannot correct the mistake without leave of the appellate court.

(Choice A) A district court need not provide the parties with notice or an opportunity to be heard before it corrects a mistake.

(Choice C) The district court could have corrected the mistake on its own initiative had the appeal not been docketed.

(Choice D) A district court cannot freely alter or amend final judgments. It may do so only when:
  • the judgment is based on a manifest error of law or fact,
  • the controlling law has changed, or
  • new evidence is discovered.


Educational objective: Before an appeal is docketed in the appellate court, a district court can correct a mistake in a judgment, order, or other part of the record on its own initiative or pursuant to a party's motion. But after an appeal has been docketed, the district court can correct the mistake only with the appellate court's leave.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

审后错误的纠正


(FRCP 60(a)) 错误类型定义纠正时间
笔误对法院意图的错误陈述
例如，法院判决为“$10,000”，而非“$100,000”		上诉立卷前：法院主动或依动议
上诉立卷后：需经上诉法院许可
疏忽/遗漏因遗漏而错误地表达了法院的意图
例如，判决未能将必要的利息包括在赔偿金中
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (联邦民事诉讼规则)。

地区法院可以纠正判决、命令或记录其他部分中的笔误或因疏忽或遗漏而产生的错误。法院可以在判决或命令的上诉立卷之前，主动或根据一方当事人的动议进行纠正。但在上诉立卷之后，地区法院只有在获得上诉法院的许可（即permission）后才能纠正该错误。

在本案中，发生了一个笔误，因为陪审团裁决原告获得100,000美元，但终局判决却判给她1,000,000美元。由于上诉已经立卷，地区法院未经上诉法院许可不得纠正该错误。

(选项 A) 地区法院在纠正错误前，无需向双方当事人提供通知或听证的机会。

(选项 C) 如果上诉尚未立卷，地区法院本可以主动纠正该错误。

(选项 D) 地区法院不能自由地更改或修正终局判决。只有在以下情况下才可以这样做：
  • 判决基于明显的法律或事实错误，
  • 管辖法律发生了变化，或
  • 发现了新的证据。


教学目的：在上诉于上诉法院立卷之前，地区法院可以主动或根据一方当事人的动议，纠正判决、命令或记录其他部分中的错误。但在上诉立卷之后，地区法院只有在获得上诉法院的许可后才能纠正该错误。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 60(a) (correction of mistake in judgment or order).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Correction of Mistakes
⚖️ 核心考点：FRCP 60(a)

联邦民事诉讼规则第 60(a) 条 规定了法院如何纠正判决中的“笔误”（Clerical Mistakes）。

关键在于时间点：一旦上诉在上诉法院立卷（Docketed），地区法院就失去了单方面纠正错误的管辖权。

📝 案情关键点分析

本案中，陪审团裁决 $100,000，但判决书写成了 $1,000,000。这显然是一个笔误 (Clerical Mistake)，即判决未能正确反映法院或陪审团的真实意图，而非实质性的法律错误。

但是，题目中有一个决定性的时间节点：“The appellate court docketed the case” (上诉法院已将该案立卷)。

判决作出 (Judgment Entered)
存在笔误 ($1M vs $100k)
提交上诉通知 (Notice of Appeal Filed)
此时地区法院通常仍有权纠正笔误
上诉立卷 (Appeal Docketed) ⚠️
管辖权转移！ 案件正式进入上诉法院系统。
地区法院发现错误
此时若要纠正，必须获得上诉法院的许可 (Leave of the appellate court)。

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

理由：根据 FRCP 60(a)，在上诉立卷（docketed）之后，地区法院纠正笔误的权力受到限制，必须先获得上诉法院的许可（Leave）。如果没有这个许可，地区法院无权修改判决。

❌ 选项 A 错误
FRCP 60(a) 允许法院在“不通知”的情况下纠正笔误（虽然通常会通知）。这里的核心障碍不是通知（Notice），而是管辖权（Jurisdiction）。
❌ 选项 C 错误
如果上诉尚未立卷，法院确实可以“主动”（on its own initiative）纠正。但本题明确指出案件已立卷，因此该选项不再适用。
❌ 选项 D 错误
地区法院不能“自由地”（freely）更改终局判决。修改判决有严格的标准（如 FRCP 59(e) 或 60(b)），且“为了司法公正”这一理由过于宽泛，不能凌驾于上诉期间的管辖权规则之上。
💡 MBE 答题技巧

在涉及上诉 (Appeal) 的题目中，务必区分两个动作：
  1. Filing Notice of Appeal（提交上诉通知）：通常在地区法院进行。
  2. Docketing the Appeal（上诉立卷）：在上诉法院进行。
FRCP 60(a) 的分界线是“Docketing”。看到这个词，就要立刻反应：地区法院的手被束缚了，需要上级法院点头（Leave）才能动笔。

A patient filed a medical malpractice action against a hospital in federal court, alleging that hospital staff had failed to diagnose the patient's cancer based on an X-ray that had been taken at the hospital. The patient's cancer was diagnosed six months later, based on the same X-ray, when he sought a second opinion. In the interim, the cancer had spread.
Fact and expert discovery have been completed in the action. The hospital has moved for summary judgment. In support of its motion, the hospital has submitted a memorandum identifying facts that it claims are not in dispute. It has also cited and attached supporting exhibits, including a declaration signed under penalty of perjury from the hospital's radiologist, who found no signs of cancer on the X-ray.
What is the best way for the patient to raise a genuine dispute of material fact?

choices.a: Submit a report from the patient's expert radiologist contradicting the findings in the declaration of the hospital's radiologist.
choices.b: Submit an affidavit from the patient's attorney detailing his conversations with the patient's expert radiologist.
choices.c: Submit an affidavit from the patient's expert radiologist with findings that contradict the declaration of the hospital's radiologist.
choices.d: Submit the patient's medical records showing his current cancer diagnosis.

Q88815 A patient filed a medical malpractice action against a hospital in federal court, alleging that hospital staff had failed to diagnose the patient's cancer based on an X-ray that had been taken at the hospital. The patient's cancer was diagnosed six months later, based on the same X-ray, when he sought a second opinion. In the interim, the cancer had spread.

Fact and expert discovery have been completed in the action. The hospital has moved for summary judgment. In support of its motion, the hospital has submitted a memorandum identifying facts that it claims are not in dispute. It has also cited and attached supporting exhibits, including a declaration signed under penalty of perjury from the hospital's radiologist, who found no signs of cancer on the X-ray.

What is the best way for the patient to raise a genuine dispute of material fact? 一名患者在联邦法院对一家医院提起医疗事故诉讼，指控医院工作人员未能根据在该医院拍摄的X光片诊断出该患者的癌症。六个月后，当该患者寻求第二诊疗意见时，根据同一张X光片，其癌症得到了诊断。在此期间，癌症已经扩散。

诉讼中的事实证据开示和专家证据开示已经完成。医院已提出即决判决动议。为支持其动议，医院提交了一份备忘录，指明其声称不存在争议的事实。医院还引用并附上了支持性证物，包括一份由医院放射科医生在伪证罪处罚下签署的陈述书，该医生声称在X光片上未发现癌症迹象。

患者提出重大事实的真实争议的最佳方式是什么？
options:
A. Submit a report from the patient's expert radiologist contradicting the findings in the declaration of the hospital's radiologist.
提交一份来自患者的专家放射科医生的报告，反驳医院放射科医生陈述书中的结论。

B. Submit an affidavit from the patient's attorney detailing his conversations with the patient's expert radiologist.
提交一份来自患者律师的宣誓书，详细说明其与患者的专家放射科医生的对话。

C. Submit an affidavit from the patient's expert radiologist with findings that contradict the declaration of the hospital's radiologist.
提交一份来自患者的专家放射科医生的宣誓书，其结论与医院放射科医生的陈述书相矛盾。

D. Submit the patient's medical records showing his current cancer diagnosis.
提交显示患者当前癌症诊断的医疗记录。
data.explanation:
Motion for summary judgment
(FRCP 56)


Time to file
  • Motion may be filed until 30 days after close of discovery OR time set by local rule or court
Burden of proof
  • Movant has initial burden to establish standard
    • may support by relying on pleadings, affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible facts
  • If initial burden is met, burden shifts to nonmovant to either:
    • show specific disputed facts through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible facts (cannot rely on pleadings) or
    • request postponement for additional discovery & support with affidavit or declaration
Standard for grant
  • No genuine dispute as to any material fact AND movant entitled to judgment as a matter of law
    • evidence must be viewed in light most favorable to nonmovant
    • all doubts must be resolved in nonmovant's favor

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A court should grant summary judgment in lieu of a full trial when (1) there is no genuine dispute of material fact and (2) the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law. The nonmovant can raise a genuine dispute of material fact through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible facts. Affidavits are written statements sworn in the presence of a notary public, and declarations are written statements signed under penalty of perjury. They can be used in determining a summary judgment if they:

  • are based on the affiant's or declarant's personal knowledge
  • contain admissible facts and
  • show that the affiant or declarant is competent to testify to the matters stated therein.

Here, the hospital's radiologist stated in his declaration that he found no signs of cancer on the patient's X-ray. The patient can genuinely dispute this material fact by submitting an affidavit from his expert radiologist with findings that contradict the declaration. This affidavit can be used since the patient's radiologist has personal knowledge of the patient's X-ray, the findings are likely admissible, and the radiologist is competent to testify about this subject.

(Choice A) Most courts will not consider expert reports in deciding summary judgment motions because they are not sworn or signed under penalty of perjury and therefore contain inadmissible facts.

(Choice B) An affidavit from the patient's attorney detailing his conversations with the patient's radiologist is not valid since it (1) is not based on the attorney's personal knowledge of the patient's X-ray, (2) contains inadmissible hearsay, and (3) does not show that the attorney is competent to testify on medical issues.

(Choice D) The patient's medical records showing his current cancer diagnosis do not dispute whether there were signs of cancer on the X-ray taken before his diagnosis.

Educational objective:
In a motion for summary judgment, the nonmovant can raise a genuine issue of material fact through affidavits and declarations that (1) are based on the affiant's or declarant's personal knowledge, (2) set out admissible facts, and (3) show the affiant's or declarant's competency to testify to the matters stated therein.



即决判决动议
（《联邦民事诉讼规则》第56条）


提交时间
  • 动议可在证据开示结束后30天内或根据地方法院规则或法院设定的时间之前提交
举证责任
  • 动议方负有确立标准的初始责任
    • 可通过依赖诉状、宣誓书、陈述书、证据开示或其他包含可采纳事实的材料来支持
  • 如果初始责任已满足，则责任转移至非动议方，其需：
    • 通过宣誓书、陈述书、证据开示或其他包含可采纳事实的材料来证明存在具体的争议事实（不能仅依赖诉状）或
    • 请求延期以进行额外的证据开示，并以宣誓书或陈述书支持
批准标准
  • 不存在任何重大事实的真实争议，且动议方有权获得法律上的判决
    • 证据必须以对非动议方最有利的方式看待
    • 所有疑问必须以对非动议方有利的方式解决

FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》。

当 (1) 不存在重大事实的真实争议，且 (2) 动议方有权获得法律上的判决时，法院应批准即决判决以代替全面审判。非动议方可以通过宣誓书、陈述书、证据开示或其他包含可采纳事实的材料来提出重大事实的真实争议。宣誓书 (Affidavits) 是在公证人面前宣誓的书面陈述，而陈述书 (declarations) 是在伪证罪处罚下签署的书面陈述。如果在裁定即决判决时，它们符合以下条件，则可以被采纳：

  • 基于宣誓人或陈述人的个人认知
  • 包含可采纳的事实，并且
  • 表明宣誓人或陈述人有资格就其中陈述的事项作证。

在本案中，医院的放射科医生在其陈述书中声称，他在患者的X光片上未发现癌症迹象。患者可以通过提交其专家放射科医生的宣誓书来真实地反驳这一重大事实，该宣誓书中的结论与前述陈述书相矛盾。这份宣誓书可以被采纳，因为患者的放射科医生对患者的X光片有个人认知，其结论很可能是可采纳的，并且该放射科医生有资格就此主题作证。

（选项A）大多数法院在裁定即决判决动议时不会考虑专家报告，因为这些报告未经宣誓或在伪证罪处罚下签署，因此包含不可采纳的事实。

（选项B）由患者律师出具的、详细说明其与患者放射科医生对话的宣誓书是无效的，因为它 (1) 并非基于律师对患者X光片的个人认知，(2) 包含不可采纳的传闻证据，并且 (3) 未能表明该律师有资格就医疗问题作证。

（选项D）显示患者当前癌症诊断的医疗记录，并不能反驳在其诊断之前拍摄的X光片上是否存在癌症迹象的问题。

教学目标：
在即决判决动议中，非动议方可以通过宣誓书和陈述书提出重大事实的真实争议，前提是这些文件 (1) 基于宣誓人或陈述人的个人认知，(2) 陈述了可采纳的事实，以及 (3) 表明了宣誓人或陈述人有资格就其中所述事项作证。



References


  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 56(c) (support for factual positions on summary judgment).

MBE Civil Procedure
即决判决与证据对抗

核心考点：FRCP 56

本题考察的是即决判决 (Summary Judgment) 阶段的举证责任转移与证据形式要求。

法律规则 (Rule):
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第56条 (FRCP 56)，如果动议方 (Movant) 证明不存在重大事实的真实争议 (Genuine Dispute of Material Fact)，且其有权获得法律上的判决，法院应批准即决判决。

举证责任的转移 (Burden Shifting)

1. 动议方（医院）：通过提交放射科医生的陈述书 (Declaration)，证明X光片上没有癌症迹象，从而履行了初始举证责任。

2. 非动议方（患者）：责任转移至患者。患者必须拿出具体的证据，证明X光片上确实有癌症迹象，从而制造出一个需要陪审团裁决的事实争议。

正确答案：选项 C

为什么选 C？

提交患者专家放射科医生的宣誓书 (Affidavit)。

这是典型的“专家之战” (Battle of the Experts)。要击败即决判决，患者需要：

  • 形式合规： 使用宣誓书 (Affidavit) 或 陈述书 (Declaration)。这是FRCP 56(c)(4)明确要求的证据形式。
  • 内容实质： 专家必须基于个人认知 (Personal Knowledge)（即亲自查看了X光片），并具备作证资格 (Competence to Testify)。
  • 制造争议： 医院专家说“没癌症”，患者专家说“有癌症”。这就是最标准的“重大事实争议”，法院不能在即决判决阶段自行判断谁对谁错，必须留给陪审团。

常见陷阱分析

选项 A 错误

未宣誓的专家报告 (Unsworn Report)：
虽然内容是对的，但形式是错的。大多数法院在即决判决阶段不接受未经宣誓的专家报告，因为它们属于不可采纳的传闻证据 (Inadmissible Hearsay)。必须有“Penalty of Perjury”（伪证罪处罚）的约束。

选项 B 错误

律师的宣誓书 (Attorney's Affidavit)：
这是双重错误： 1. 传闻证据： 律师转述专家的话是Hearsay。 2. 缺乏个人认知： 律师不是医生，没有资格对X光片的医疗内容作证。

选项 D 错误

当前的诊断记录：
这属于相关性 (Relevance) 问题。现在的癌症确诊不能证明6个月前的X光片上是否有可见的癌症迹象。医疗事故的核心是“当时是否违反了注意义务”。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理 Summary Judgment 题目时，如果动议方提交了宣誓过的专家证言，非动议方（你）通常必须用同样级别的证据（即另一份宣誓过的专家证言）来反击。

记住公式：
Unsworn Report ❌
Attorney's Hearsay ❌
Expert Affidavit/Declaration ✅

questions.question:
A man in State A posted his exotic car for sale on a website. He received an email with an offer to buy the car for $150,000 from a 16-year-old girl from State B. The man accepted the girl's offer but received a phone call from the girl's father rescinding the offer the following day.
The man filed a complaint in a federal court in State A against the girl for breach of contract. The girl timely filed an answer in which she admitted to the facts provided in the man's complaint but asserted the affirmative defense of accord and satisfaction. The man moved for judgment on the pleadings.
Statutes in both State A and State B treat contracts with persons below the age of 18 for items other than necessities as void. Necessities are defined as food, shelter, and clothing.
Is the court likely to grant the man's motion?

choices.a: No, because plaintiffs cannot move for judgment on the pleadings.
choices.b: No, because the man failed to state a claim upon which relief may be granted.
choices.c: Yes, because accord and satisfaction is not a valid defense in this case.
choices.d: Yes, because the girl admitted to the facts alleged in the man's complaint.

A man in State A posted his exotic car for sale on a website. He received an email with an offer to buy the car for $150,000 from a 16-year-old girl from State B. The man accepted the girl's offer but received a phone call from the girl's father rescinding the offer the following day.

The man filed a complaint in a federal court in State A against the girl for breach of contract. The girl timely filed an answer in which she admitted to the facts provided in the man's complaint but asserted the affirmative defense of accord and satisfaction. The man moved for judgment on the pleadings.

Statutes in both State A and State B treat contracts with persons below the age of 18 for items other than necessities as void. Necessities are defined as food, shelter, and clothing.

Is the court likely to grant the man's motion?

A州的一名男子在网站上挂牌出售其一辆豪华汽车。他收到一封来自B州一名16岁女孩的电子邮件，要约以15万美元的价格购买该车。该男子接受了女孩的要约，但第二天接到女孩父亲的电话，撤销了该要约。

该男子以违约为由，向A州联邦法院对该女孩提起诉讼。女孩及时提交了答辩状，承认了男子诉状中陈述的事实，但主张了和解与清偿的积极抗辩。该男子申请基于诉状的判决。

A州和B州的法规均规定，未满18周岁的人签订的非必需品合同无效。必需品被定义为食物、住所和衣物。

法院是否可能批准该男子的动议？
options:
A. No, because plaintiffs cannot move for judgment on the pleadings.
不会，因为原告不能申请基于诉状的判决。

B. No, because the man failed to state a claim upon which relief may be granted.
不会，因为该男子未能陈述一项可以获得救济的诉讼请求。

C. Yes, because accord and satisfaction is not a valid defense in this case.
会，因为在本案中，和解与清偿并非有效的抗辩理由。

D. Yes, because the girl admitted to the facts alleged in the man's complaint.
会，因为女孩承认了男子诉状中所指控的事实。
data.explanation:
Pretrial motions


MotionGrounds
Default judgmentDefendant failed to timely serve answer Any party failed to comply with court order
Pre-answerNo subject-matter or personal jurisdiction Improper venue Insufficient process or service or process Failure to join required party Failure to state claim upon which relief can be granted
Judgment on the pleadingsPleadings, attached exhibits & matters of public record show (1) no genuine dispute of material fact & (2) movant entitled to judgment as a matter of law
Voluntary dismissalPlaintiff requests dismissal
Involuntary dismissalDefendant requests dismissal because plaintiff failed to (1) prosecute action or (2) comply with rule/court order
Summary judgmentPleadings, affidavits, declarations, discovery & other materials show (1) no genuine dispute of material fact & (2) movant entitled to judgment as a matter of law
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12(c), any party may move for judgment on the pleadings after the pleadings have closed - ie, once the plaintiff's complaint and the defendant's answer have been served (Choice A). To succeed on this motion, the movant must show that (1) there is no genuine issue of material fact and (2) the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

Here, there are no genuine issues of material fact since the girl admitted to the facts alleged in the man's complaint for breach of contract (Choice D). But since the girl is under the age of majority and a car is not a necessity under either state's statute, the contract was void. This means that the man failed to state a claim upon which relief may be granted and is not entitled to judgment as a matter of law. Therefore, the court will likely deny the man's motion for judgment on the pleadings.

(Choice C) An accord is a party's promise to relieve another person of contractual obligations in return for a specific act. Upon satisfaction of that act, that person is excused from further performance under the contract. Accord and satisfaction is not a valid affirmative defense here since the contract was void. However, the man cannot succeed on his motion since he failed to state a valid claim.

Educational objective: A court should enter judgment on the pleadings when the movant shows that (1) there is no genuine issue of material fact and (2) the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 68%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

审前动议


动议理由
缺席判决被告未能及时送达答辩状
任何一方未能遵守法院命令
答辩前动议无标的物管辖权或对人管辖权
审判地点不当
诉讼文书或送达不充分
未能合并必要的当事人
未能陈述可获救济的诉讼请求
基于诉状的判决诉状、附加证物及公共记录事项表明 (1) 不存在重大事实的真实争议 & (2) 动议申请人有权依法律获得判决
自愿撤诉原告请求撤诉
非自愿撤诉/驳回被告因原告未能 (1) 推进诉讼或 (2) 遵守规则/法院命令而请求驳回
即决判决诉状、宣誓书、声明、证据开示及其他材料表明 (1) 不存在重大事实的真实争议 & (2) 动议申请人有权依法律获得判决
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(c)条，在诉状提交结束后——即原告的诉状和被告的答辩状都已送达后——任何一方当事人都可以申请基于诉状的判决 (选项 A)。要使此动议成功，动议申请人必须证明 (1) 不存在重大事实的真实争议，以及 (2) 动议申请人有权依法律获得判决。

在本案中，不存在重大事实的真实争议，因为女孩承认了男子在违约诉状中指控的事实 (选项 D)。但是，由于女孩未成年，且根据两州法规，汽车不属于必需品，因此该合同无效。这意味着该男子未能陈述一项可以获得救济的诉讼请求，并且无权依法律获得判决。因此，法院可能会驳回该男子基于诉状的判决的动议。

(选项 C) 和解协议 (accord) 是一方当事人承诺通过一个特定行为来免除另一方当事人的合同义务。在该行为得到履行 (satisfaction) 后，该当事人即可免除合同下的进一步履行责任。由于合同无效，和解与清偿在此处并非有效的积极抗辩。然而，由于该男子未能提出有效的诉讼请求，他的动议无法成功。

教学目的：当动议申请人证明 (1) 不存在重大事实的真实争议，且 (2) 动议申请人有权依法律获得判决时，法院应作出基于诉状的判决。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(c) (judgment on the pleadings).
  • 61A Am. Jur. 2d Pleading § 560 (2020) (explaining that movant must allege some viable legal theory to succeed on motion for judgment on the pleadings).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：民事诉讼与合同效力
正确答案：B 不会，因为该男子未能陈述一项可以获得救济的诉讼请求 (failed to state a claim upon which relief may be granted)。
核心考点：基于诉状的判决

本题考察的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(c)条下的基于诉状的判决 (Judgment on the Pleadings)。

动议成功的两个必要条件：
  1. 无事实争议： 双方对重大事实 (Material Facts) 没有真正的争议。
  2. 法律上有权胜诉： 动议方 (Movant) 必须证明，基于无可争议的事实，其在法律上有权获得判决 (Entitled to judgment as a matter of law)。
法律分析与推理

1. 事实层面 (Factual Prong)：
虽然被告（女孩）承认了原告（男子）诉状中的所有事实（要约、承诺、未付款），这满足了第一个条件“无事实争议”。

2. 法律层面 (Legal Prong) —— 关键点：
即使事实都成立，原告必须证明他在法律上能赢。然而，题目中明确指出 A 州和 B 州的法规规定：

  • 未满18岁者签订的非必需品合同是无效的 (Void)。
  • 汽车不属于必需品 (Necessities)。

结论：
因为合同在法律上是无效的 (Void)，它自始至终都不产生法律效力。即使女孩承认她签了字、答应了买车，法院也无法基于一个无效的合同判决原告胜诉。

因此，原告的诉状实际上揭示了他“未能陈述一项可以获得救济的诉讼请求”。这通常是 Rule 12(b)(6) 的驳回理由，但在 Rule 12(c) 阶段，如果诉状显示原告在法律上根本站不住脚，法院将拒绝原告的胜诉动议（甚至可能直接判被告胜诉）。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A (错误)： 原告和被告均可提出 Rule 12(c) 动议，并不局限于被告。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 虽然“和解与清偿” (Accord and Satisfaction) 确实可能不是本案的有效抗辩（因为合同本身就无效，无需谈和解），但这并不能让原告自动胜诉。原告输在起跑线上（合同无效），而不是输在被告的抗辩上。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 这是一个典型的陷阱。承认事实 ≠ 承担法律责任。女孩承认了事实，但法律规定这些事实不能构成有效的合同责任。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在处理 Rule 12(c) 或 Summary Judgment 问题时，不要只看是否有“事实争议”。必须时刻检查实体法 (Substantive Law) 是否支持动议方的请求。如果基础法律关系（如本题中的合同）不成立，即便事实全盘承认，原告也无法胜诉。

questions.question:
A consumer from State A sued a fireworks manufacturer from State B in federal court. The consumer claimed that she suffered severe burns when the fuses on the manufacturer's fireworks malfunctioned. At the conclusion of trial, the jury awarded the consumer $200,000 for her medical bills, $50,000 for her lost wages, and $5 million for her pain and suffering. The court entered judgment consistent with this verdict.
The consumer then filed a motion claiming that the amount of damages awarded for her medical bills and lost wages are inadequate and requesting that the court increase these awards. The manufacturer filed a motion claiming that the amount of damages awarded for pain and suffering is excessive and requesting that the court decrease that amount or order a new trial on damages. The court agrees with both parties' contentions.
How will the court likely rule on the parties' motions?

choices.a: Deny both motions.
choices.b: Deny the consumer's motion and grant the manufacturer's motion.
choices.c: Grant both motions.
choices.d: Grant the consumer's motion and deny the manufacturer's motion.

data.questionStem:
Q88126

A consumer from State A sued a fireworks manufacturer from State B in federal court. The consumer claimed that she suffered severe burns when the fuses on the manufacturer's fireworks malfunctioned. At the conclusion of trial, the jury awarded the consumer $200,000 for her medical bills, $50,000 for her lost wages, and $5 million for her pain and suffering. The court entered judgment consistent with this verdict.

The consumer then filed a motion claiming that the amount of damages awarded for her medical bills and lost wages are inadequate and requesting that the court increase these awards. The manufacturer filed a motion claiming that the amount of damages awarded for pain and suffering is excessive and requesting that the court decrease that amount or order a new trial on damages. The court agrees with both parties' contentions.

How will the court likely rule on the parties' motions?

一名来自A州的消费者在联邦法院起诉了一家来自B州的烟花制造商。该消费者声称，由于制造商的烟花引信失灵，她遭受了严重烧伤。庭审结束时，陪审团裁决赔偿该消费者医疗费用20万美元，误工费5万美元，以及精神和肉体痛苦赔偿500万美元。法院根据该裁决作出了判决。

随后，该消费者提交了一项动议，主张其医疗费用和误工费的损害赔偿金额不足，并请求法院增加这些赔偿金额。制造商则提交了一项动议，主张精神和肉体痛苦的损害赔偿金额过高，并请求法院减少该金额或就损害赔偿问题下令进行新的庭审。法院同意双方的主张。

法院将可能如何裁定双方的动议？
options:
A. Deny both motions.
驳回双方的动议。

B. Deny the consumer's motion and grant the manufacturer's motion.
驳回消费者的动议，并批准制造商的动议。

C. Grant both motions.
批准双方的动议。

D. Grant the consumer's motion and deny the manufacturer's motion.
批准消费者的动议，并驳回制造商的动议。
data.explanation:
Altering jury's award of damages


(FRCP 59(e)) Type of alterationDefinitionApplicability
RemittiturDefendant's request to reduce jury award of excessive damagesPlaintiff must be offered choice between: reduced damages or new trial on damages
AdditurPlaintiff's request to increase jury award of inadequate damagesNever allowed in federal court

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

Additur is a request that a court increase an allegedly inadequate jury award of damages. Additur is permitted in many state courts, but it is not allowed in federal court because it violates the Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial. That is because additur allows the court to grant an award of damages that was not found by the jury - the ultimate finder of fact. Therefore, the court will deny the consumer's request to increase the jury award of damages for medical bills and lost wages (Choices C & D).

Remittitur, in contrast, is a request that the court reduce an allegedly excessive jury award of damages. If the request is granted, the opposing party must choose between (1) a reduction in damages or (2) a new trial on damages. Remittitur does not violate the Seventh Amendment because the jury has already determined the damages and the court is simply trimming the excess. Since the court agrees that the damages for pain and suffering are excessive, it will likely grant the manufacturer's motion regarding those damages (Choices A & D).

The Seventh Amendment has never been applied to the states, so states need not provide a jury trial to civil litigants.

Educational objective: A federal court cannot grant a request to increase an allegedly inadequate jury award of damages (ie, additur), but it can reduce an allegedly excessive jury award or order a new trial on damages (ie, remittitur).



选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 57%（正确选项），C选项 27%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

更改陪审团的损害赔偿裁决


(FRCP 59(e)) 更改类型定义适用性
损害赔偿额酌减 (Remittitur)被告请求减少陪审团裁决的过高损害赔偿额必须向原告提供以下选择：减少损害赔偿额或就损害赔偿问题进行新的庭审
损害赔偿额酌增 (Additur)原告请求增加陪审团裁决的不足损害赔偿额在联邦法院中绝不允许

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)

损害赔偿额酌增 (Additur) 是指向法院请求增加据称不足的陪审团损害赔偿裁决额。损害赔偿额酌增在许多州法院是允许的，但在联邦法院不被允许，因为它违反了第七修正案 (Seventh Amendment) 规定的由陪审团审理的权利。 这是因为损害赔偿额酌增允许法院裁定一个未经陪审团（事实的最终裁断者）裁定的损害赔偿数额。因此，法院将驳回消费者增加医疗费用和误工费损害赔偿裁决额的请求（选项C和D）。

与此相反，损害赔偿额酌减 (Remittitur) 是指向法院请求减少据称过高的陪审团损害赔偿裁决额。如果该请求被批准，另一方当事人必须在（1）减少损害赔偿额或（2）就损害赔偿问题进行新的庭审之间做出选择。损害赔偿额酌减并不违反第七修正案 (Seventh Amendment)，因为陪审团已经确定了损害赔偿金，法院只是削减了过高的部分。由于法院同意精神和肉体痛苦的损害赔偿金过高，它很可能会批准制造商就该损害赔偿提出的动议（选项A和D）。

第七修正案 (Seventh Amendment) 从未适用于各州，因此各州无需为民事诉讼当事人提供陪审团审理。

教学目标：联邦法院不能批准增加据称不足的陪审团损害赔偿裁决额的请求（即，损害赔偿额酌增 additur），但可以减少据称过高的陪审团损害赔偿裁决额或下令就损害赔偿问题进行新的庭审（即，损害赔偿额酌减 remittitur）。



References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 59 (motions for additur and remittitur).
  • Dimick v. Schiedt, 293 U.S. 474, 486 - 87 (1935) (holding that additur violates the Seventh Amendment).
  • Hetzel v. Prince William Cty., 523 U.S. 208, 211 - 12 (1998) (explaining the requirements for remittitur).

MBE 考点解析

联邦民事诉讼中的赔偿额调整

正确答案 选项 B
驳回消费者的动议，批准制造商的动议

本题的核心考点在于联邦法院对第七修正案 (Seventh Amendment) 中陪审团审判权的解释，具体涉及两个概念：Additur（增额）和 Remittitur（减额）。

1. 消费者的动议：Additur (增额)
动议内容： 请求法院增加陪审团裁定的“不足”赔偿金。
法律规则： Additur 在联邦法院是违宪的。
结果： 驳回 (Deny)

深度解析：
最高法院在 Dimick v. Schiedt (1935) 案中裁定，联邦法院不允许使用 Additur。理由是，如果法官增加了陪审团从未裁定过的赔偿金额，这实质上是在代替陪审团认定事实，侵犯了第七修正案赋予当事人的陪审团审判权 (Right to Jury Trial)。

因此，无论法院是否同意消费者的医疗费和误工费赔偿过低，联邦法官都无权直接增加赔偿金额。

2. 制造商的动议：Remittitur (减额)
动议内容： 请求法院减少陪审团裁定的“过高”赔偿金。
法律规则： Remittitur 在联邦法院是允许的。
结果： 批准 (Grant)

深度解析：
Remittitur 被认为是合宪的。当法官认为陪审团的裁决金额高得离谱（shocks the conscience）时，法官可以介入。

操作方式： 法院不能直接更改数字，而是必须给原告一个选择权：
1. 接受减少后的赔偿金额；或者
2. 接受针对赔偿金额的新庭审 (New trial on damages)。
这并没有凭空“创造”一个裁决，而只是削减了过高的部分，因此不违反第七修正案。

考点对比总结
特性 Additur (增额) Remittitur (减额)
定义 法官增加赔偿金 法官减少赔偿金
联邦法院 禁止 (违宪) 允许
州法院 许多州允许* 几乎所有州允许
*注：第七修正案的民事陪审团权利未通过第十四修正案适用于各州。
💡 MBE 解题技巧：
看到题目发生在联邦法院 (Federal Court) 且涉及修改赔偿金额时，请记住口诀：
"Federal Court: Can Subtract, Cannot Add."

(联邦法院：可以减，不能加。)

如果题目发生在州法院，Additur 可能是允许的，但 MBE 民事诉讼法部分主要考察联邦规则 (FRCP)，除非题目明确问及州法差异。

questions.question:
A firm sued a corporation in a federal district court for allegedly engaging in unfair trade practices in violation of a federal statute. The firm sought $100,000 and an injunction. At the conclusion of a bench trial, the judge announced her findings of fact and conclusions of law on the record, and judgment was entered in favor of the corporation.
Twenty-eight days later, the firm discovered a legal theory it initially overlooked that entitles it to relief. That same day, the firm filed a motion for a new trial based on this newly discovered legal theory.
Is the court likely to grant the firm's motion?

choices.a: No, because the legal theory could have been asserted at trial.
choices.b: No, because the motion was not timely made.
choices.c: Yes, because the judge's factual findings and legal conclusions were not in writing.
choices.d: Yes, because the legal theory shows that the firm is entitled to relief.

A firm sued a corporation in a federal district court for allegedly engaging in unfair trade practices in violation of a federal statute. The firm sought $100,000 and an injunction. At the conclusion of a bench trial, the judge announced her findings of fact and conclusions of law on the record, and judgment was entered in favor of the corporation.

Twenty-eight days later, the firm discovered a legal theory it initially overlooked that entitles it to relief. That same day, the firm filed a motion for a new trial based on this newly discovered legal theory.

Is the court likely to grant the firm's motion?

一家原告公司在联邦地区法院起诉一家被告公司，指控其涉嫌从事不正当交易行为，违反了一项联邦法规。原告公司寻求10万美元赔偿及一项禁令。在一次无陪审团审判结束后，法官当庭宣布了她的事实认定和法律结论，并作出了有利于被告公司的判决。

二十八天后，原告公司发现了一个其最初忽略的、能使其获得救济的法律理论。同一天，原告公司基于这个新发现的法律理论，提出了一项要求重新审判的动议。

法院是否可能批准原告公司的动议？
options:
A. No, because the legal theory could have been asserted at trial.
不会，因为该法律理论本可以在审判中主张。

B. No, because the motion was not timely made.
不会，因为该动议未及时提出。

C. Yes, because the judge's factual findings and legal conclusions were not in writing.
会，因为法官的事实认定和法律结论没有书面形式。

D. Yes, because the legal theory shows that the firm is entitled to relief.
会，因为该法律理论表明原告公司有权获得救济。
data.explanation:
Grounds for new trial


Prejudicial trial error (eg, erroneous evidentiary ruling)
Prejudicial misconduct by judge, attorney, party, or juror
Verdict not supported by clear weight of evidence
Verdict based on false/nonexistent evidence
Excessive or inadequate damages
Newly discovered evidence
A party can move for a new trial within 28 days after the entry of final judgment, as the firm did here (Choice B). A court may grant a new trial on several grounds. But it will not grant a new trial based on a newly discovered legal theory that the party could have raised at trial - even if the theory entitles the party to relief (Choice D). This encourages attorneys to fully investigate their case before trial is over so that the case can be resolved without perpetual reexamination.

(Choice C) After the close of evidence in a bench trial, the judge must provide - orally or in writing - findings of fact and conclusions of law on the record.

Educational objective: A new trial cannot be granted based on a newly discovered legal theory that could have been raised at trial.

选项正确率统计：A选项 82%（正确选项），B选项 6%，C选项 1%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

重新审判的理由


审判中有损公正的错误（例如，错误的证据裁决）
法官、律师、当事人或陪审员有损公正的不当行为
裁决没有得到明显优势证据的支持
裁决基于虚假或不存在的证据
损害赔偿金过多或不足
新发现的证据
当事人可以在终局判决作出后的28天内提出重新审判的动议，正如本案中的原告公司所做的那样（选项B）。法院可基于若干理由批准重新审判。但法院不会基于当事人本可以在审判中提出的新发现的法律理论而批准重新审判——即使该理论能使当事人获得救济（选项D）。这鼓励律师在审判结束前全面调查其案件，以便案件能够得到解决，而无需无休止的重新审查。

（选项C）在无陪审团审判的证据调查结束后，法官必须以口头或书面形式，将事实认定和法律结论记录在案。

教学目标：不能基于一个本可以在审判中提出的新发现的法律理论而批准重新审判。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 59 (motion for a new trial).
  • 58 Am. Jur. 2d New Trial § 320 (2019) (explaining that a new legal theory or defense is not a basis for a new trial).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：重新审判动议

Civil Procedure Rule 59

本题考察的核心是联邦民事诉讼规则第59条（Fed. R. Civ. P. 59）关于重新审判（New Trial）的理由限制。

正确答案：A
法院不会批准动议，因为该法律理论本可以在审判中主张。

1. 核心法律规则解析

在联邦法院，当事人可以在判决登记后 28天 内提出重新审判动议（Motion for a New Trial）。虽然法院有很大的自由裁量权，但批准重新审判必须基于特定的理由，例如：

  • 程序错误 (Prejudicial error)：如错误的证据裁决。
  • 不当行为 (Misconduct)：法官、律师或陪审员的不当行为。
  • 证据权重 (Weight of evidence)：裁决明显违背证据权重。
  • 新发现的证据 (Newly discovered evidence)。

关键区别：新证据 vs. 新理论

这是本题的考点所在。MBE 经常混淆这两个概念：

  • ✅ 新发现的证据： 如果证据在审判时存在但无法通过合理的勤勉（Reasonable Diligence）被发现，可以作为重审理由。
  • ❌ 新发现的法律理论： 法律理论（Legal Theory）不是证据。如果律师只是“忽略了”（Overlooked）一个本可以提出的法律论点，这属于律师的失误或策略选择。

为了保证判决的终局性（Finality of Judgment），法律不允许当事人因为事后想到了更好的辩护策略而要求重审。如果该理论在审判时客观上是可用的，当事人就视为放弃（Waived）了该主张。

2. 案情分析

在本案中：

  1. 时间性： 动议在判决后28天提出，符合 Rule 59 的时限要求。
  2. 理由： 原告公司发现了一个“最初忽略的”（Initially overlooked）法律理论。
  3. 结论： 既然是“忽略”，说明该理论在审判时是存在的，本可以被提出。因此，法院不会仅仅因为原告想到了新招数就推翻已有的判决。

3. 干扰项排除

选项 B 错误：
动议是及时的。Rule 59 规定的期限是判决登记后 28天 内。题目明确说明是“Twenty-eight days later”，正好在期限内（含第28天）。

选项 C 错误：
关于法官的裁决形式。根据 Rule 52，在无陪审团审判（Bench Trial）中，法官的事实认定（Findings of Fact）和法律结论（Conclusions of Law）可以是书面的，也可以是口头记录在案（Stated on the record）的。题目中法官已当庭宣布，程序合法。

选项 D 错误：
虽然新理论可能让原告获得救济（Entitled to relief），但程序正义（Procedural Fairness）和终局性原则优先。如果允许当事人不断提出新理论，诉讼将永无止境。错过主张的机会通常是不可逆的。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Post-trial Motions（审后动议）的题目时，请务必区分：

"Could have been raised"（本可以提出）
vs.
"Could NOT have been discovered"（无法被发现）

前者通常导致动议被驳回（Waiver），后者（仅限证据）才可能支持动议。
